diagnosis: All six natives already had external linkage and out-of-line bodies. No symbol was internal, static, inline-only or dead. The linked image emitted them under C++-mangled port identifiers (IffChunk_FindByTag, IffChunk_FindChildByTag, IffChunk_GetPayload, IffChunk_FindBelowForm, IffSkeleton_Read, App_ContextSetTerrainLightmapsUsed), so a lookup keyed on the retail catalog names (Iff_FindFormChunk, Iff_FindChunk, Iff_GetChunkPayload, Iff_FindChunkBelowForm, AnimIff_LoadAnimationFile, AppContext_SetTerrainLightmapsUsed) matched nothing. The fix is a declaration-level GCC asm-label in each owning header; the definitions, computations, argument order, return values and side effects are untouched. Baseline objects built from the pre-change headers and the post-change objects have byte-identical .text sections and identical relocation records after symbol-name mapping, so the change is name-only.
verification_effect: Addressability does not raise any status. All six remain STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED; their saved behavioral differentials are supplementary and do not establish RUNTIME_TESTED or VERIFIED.

object_level_diagnosis.why_no_symbol_matched: The function was never absent or internal. GCC emitted it under the C++ mangled port identifier, so an nm lookup keyed on the retail catalog name could not match it. The mangled name is the only difference; the body, linkage and address were already present.

assembler_name_change.mechanism: declaration-level GCC asm-label in the owning header; the definition inherits it, so the compiler emits the retail name for the same out-of-line function
assembler_name_change.declaration_text: asm-label on the declaration, inherited by the definition
assembler_name_change.no_inline_justification: Object evidence shows every one of the six bodies was already emitted out of line under -O3 (nm shows a T symbol with a distinct offset and a complete instruction stream), so no inlining suppression was needed and none was added.

body_equivalence.change_kind: symbol name only; instruction bytes and relocation records unchanged
body_equivalence.note: Compared against the object built from the pre-change headers (same compiler, same flags). All three translation units keep byte-identical .text; the emitted symbol name is the only difference.
body_equivalence.relocation_note: Compared after mapping the six renamed symbols to their retail names; every relocation offset, type and target matches.
